unit_label: BRBL C U05: Trace acquisition effects on lender rights, contracts and pending proceedings

facts.statement: Section5 permits specified acquisition arrangements; rights vest in ARC, related contracts continue subject to law, pending proceedings do not abate solely on acquisition and substitution is provided. Stamp exemption is conditional, not blanket.

payload.title: Transfer the claim without erasing its legal history
payload.core_explanation_md:
The section 5 framework allows the described acquisition arrangements between a bank or financial institution and an ARC. The ARC steps into the relevant lender rights; the acquisition is not a declaration that all debtors have paid. Related instruments and contracts continue with the statutory effects, subject to the applicable law.

A pending proceeding does not simply disappear because the financial asset has been acquired. The provision addresses continuation and substitution of the ARC in the stated circumstances. Check the actual transfer and proceeding records. The source also describes a conditional stamp exemption; it should not be advertised as exemption from every stamp or registration requirement for every document.

self_check.prompt_text: Does acquisition automatically terminate every existing recovery proceeding?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory continuation/substitution provisions must be applied.

payload.stem_md: After a stipulated section 5 acquisition, a team closes a pending proceeding solely because the original bank no longer holds the claim. Which step fits the framework?

options.text_md: Check continuation and the applicable substitution process for the ARC
options.explanation_md: Acquisition does not itself make the proceeding abate.

options.text_md: Mark the borrower fully paid despite no receipt
options.explanation_md: A transfer is not evidence of payment by the borrower.

options.text_md: Destroy the prior security documents because all contracts vanish
options.explanation_md: The framework preserves the specified related instruments and rights.

options.text_md: Assume the court has already substituted the party without an order or application record
options.explanation_md: The actual procedural records must establish the substitution.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Acquisition does not itself make the proceeding abate.

payload.stem_md: A document note says all instruments involving an ARC are automatically exempt from all stamp duties. What is the problem?

options.text_md: The statement can be proved by the ARC company name alone
options.explanation_md: Entity naming does not establish the scope of an exemption.

options.text_md: Every exemption eliminates every registration duty too
options.explanation_md: Stamp and registration issues need their own legal bases.

options.text_md: The stated exemption has a defined transaction, purpose and statutory scope
options.explanation_md: A conditional exemption cannot be expanded to every ARC document.

options.text_md: Private contract wording alone can abolish statutory duty
options.explanation_md: A private label does not create a statutory exemption.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A conditional exemption cannot be expanded to every ARC document.
